classification_limit: Function groups compare fixed declared port order. This is not NPN equivalence, and no claim of an absolute independent circuit count is made.

evaluation_policy.claims: Source logical checks do not establish routed/device-level correctness, measured power, LLM benefit, or publication priority.
evaluation_policy.primary_function_cases: Use one declared representative per function_group for function-level aggregate statistics.
evaluation_policy.representation_cases: Report all source representations separately when studying representation robustness; identify function_group and exact_duplicate_of.
evaluation_policy.same_function_pnr_comparisons: Compare algorithm results for the same frozen_sha256. A cross-representation comparison also requires matching function_group.

function_groups.interpretation: Identical complete truth tables with inputs and outputs matched by declaration order; different members are representation cases, not independent Boolean functions.
